"''It's never gonna run.|Amee and Melee, referring to Anakin Skywalker's podracer|audio=Amee-Melee.flac|}} '''Amee''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|girl]] who was born on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] in around [[38 BBY]]. She was a close friend of the [[Slavery|slave]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] and spent [[time]] socialising with him and his friends [[Wald]] and [[Kitster Banai]]. In [[32 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], which include Amee's appearance, to [[32 BBY]]. when Amee was six, the trio visited Skywalker in [[Slave Quarters Row]] with the children [[Seek]] and [[Melee]]. Skywalker, who was working on his [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer|podracer]] in a courtyard, informed them all that he would be taking part in the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing|podrace]] the next [[Standard day|day]]. The other children were dubious about Skywalker's chances in the race, and Amee doubtfully pointed out that he had been working on the vehicle for years. Seek then suggested they all go play a ball game, and Amee left the courtyard with him, Wald and Melee, giggling as they went. Skywalker went on to win the podrace and leave Tatooine. Amee was the only member of her friend group to wear [[braces]], and also wore a [[Color|brown]] [[Clothing|dress]]. She had blonde [[hair]], and fair skin. ==Behind the scenes== Amee was played by [[Katie Lucas]], daughter of director [[George Lucas]],{{SW|url=news/star-wars-a-family-affair|text=''Star Wars'', A Family Affair|nolive=1}} in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. Katie was credited under the pseudonym "Jenna Green". In the script, Amee also says Melee's only line of dialogue[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']] which is also incorrectly attributed to her in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Amee}} *{{Film|I}} {{1st}} *''[[Padawan's Pride]]'' {{Mo}} *[[Darth Vader (2020) 26|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 26]] {{Flash}} *[[Darth Vader (2020) 50|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 50]] ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[William Shakespeare's The Phantom of Menace: Star Wars Part the First]]'' ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/star-wars-a-family-affair|text=''Star Wars'', A Family Affair|nolive=1}} *''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Amee |es=Amee |fr=Amee |ja=エイミー |ka=ეიმი |nl=Amee |pl=Amee }} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:Tatooinians]]
